name: Namo Gatlin Bodhisattva
detailed_description:
Gamepad and Steam Deck Support

*"Namo Gatling Bodhisattva, pure in six senses, depleted uranium shells, thirty-six hundred revolutions per breath—great mercy saves the world."*

The Darkwood of Akali, a land overrun by monsters, where goblins are ignored by gods and heroes alike.

No one sees goblins as a threat—until they swarm in numbers, bringing the end of the world.

The prayers of Sister Ivanka go unanswered by the gods. Helpless, she flees to the Ridge Mountains in the west of the Great Sui Dynasty. And you—Namo Gatling Bodhisattva—save her. As you and Sister Ivanka begin your journey westward, the dark truths unfold. With the arrival of adventurers, their fate—and yours—changes forever. You spread your faith…

The Forgotten Frontier, ravaged by goblins.

Lead your followers to save a world torn apart by goblin hordes.

Command your disciples in turn-based battles, physically exorcising goblins with divine firepower.

Test your tactical prowess—maneuver, strike, break through, and perhaps… turn the tide of battle.

From a ragtag group of recruited adventurers to a mythical legion of devoted followers, forge the legend of Namo Gatling Bodhisattva.

Shape Your Followers

Train your team to make a difference in a world that’s as desperate as it is absurd.

Combine playable characters with unique personalities and abilities into battle formations, selecting their attack attributes, active skills, and passive skills across different development paths.

Equip them with gear and items—from simple blades and missiles to ancient scrolls that unleash apocalyptic magic. *"With the sacred artifact in hand, the world is mine!"*

Observe character bonds on the battlefield—change their relationships through personal dialogues.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10/11 (32bit/64BIT)
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card:
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.
